svg.title: Real runs become test cases.
svg.desc: A real run is recorded in the log. saveCase() writes a case directory with case.json, the log for TypeScript and Python, model.json and stubs.json. The turn is replayed offline with a scripted model built from the recorded replies, with no API keys and no network. threads eval reruns it for free in CI.
svg.text: Every step is in the log
Commit the case next to your code. TypeScript and Python read the same files.
